name: Neat school notes
description: The same neat school hand, from two pages. This is the default until a new sample is set in config.py.
note: Merged from two photographs of one neat school writer. Contours are stored from the pangrams. These photos slice letters roughly, so the page is set in the fallback handwriting font using the measured ink, slant, and spacing. Replace the photos before release if their licence is unclear.
